# Tools whose success path lands in a later work package. The stdio suite
# (mcp_stdio_test.go) still calls every tool listed here and requires a typed
# result/v1 refusal carrying exactly the pinned diagnostic codes; a tool
# removed from this file must succeed. U12 requires this file to be empty.
#
# <tool> <CODE[,CODE...]> <owner: reason>
trust_inspect TRUST_ANCHOR_MISSING U02: needs the installed trust registration fixture

settings_set TRUST_LIFECYCLE_UNAVAILABLE U07: live settings through the transaction ledger
workspace_add_service CLI_OPERATION_FAILED U07: the static fixture is not a workspace; U07 adds a workspace fixture and a typed lifecycle refusal
run TRUST_ACTION_UNAVAILABLE,TRUST_PROVENANCE_UNAVAILABLE U13: trusted manifest command execution
ai_gen TRUST_ACTION_UNAVAILABLE,TRUST_PROVENANCE_UNAVAILABLE U13: trusted AI artifact generation
